label: PF Backlog 604
title: EDP-23: Backup/PITR + restore drills (full service + single-tenant) + DB<->object integrity reconciliation + region-aware restore

brief.problem: No tested backup/PITR, restore drills, or DB<->object integrity checks — DR claims are unproven.
brief.what_adds: PITR backups, automated restore drills (service + single-tenant), integrity reconciliation, region-aware restore.
brief.why: Enterprise DR and compliance require proven, repeatable restores.
brief.who_feels: Operators, compliance teams, and enterprise customers.

objective: Deliver PITR readiness, automated full/single-tenant restore drills, DB<->object integrity reconciliation and region-aware restore guarding.
acceptance_criteria: PITR readiness check: a Go check verifies wal_level>=replica, archive_mode on/always, non-empty archive_command, and reports the archiver age/failures; failure is explicit and actionable.

Full-service restore drill: pfbackupdrill full restores a pg_dump into a scratch database, verifies schema_migrations and per-table row counts/checksums, records elapsed RTO and archive age (RPO), and drops the scratch DB.
Single-tenant restore drill: pfbackupdrill tenant exports only the tenant's rows for the core tables into a scratch DB and verifies counts plus zero cross-tenant rows (isolation).

DB<->object integrity: pfbackupdrill reconcile compares artifacts metadata with the object store, reports missing objects and orphaned objects, and repairs orphaned METADATA rows only with --repair (never deletes objects).
Region-aware restore guard: a residency mapping selects the target cell; a restore to a cell that does not match the tenant's home region is refused unless --allow-cross-region with a reason.
Tests cover PITR settings parsing, drill verification math, reconcile classification/repair guard and region routing; precheck PASS.
approach: One Go module go/backupdrill (cmd pfbackupdrill) orchestrating pg_dump/pg_restore and psql verification; reconciliation reuses datastore.ObjectStore; region mapping from config/residency-policy.json with fail-closed default.
verification: Automated restore drill in staging within RTO
Reconciliation finds seeded orphans and repairs them
risks: Restore drills are expensive and environment-heavy — risk of never-run drills
PITR granularity vs object-store consistency window mismatch
Single-tenant restore may break shared-infrastructure assumptions
rollback: Backup config changes are additive; drills run against disposable environments; reconciler has dry-run mode.

analysis.implementation_strategy: New backup/restore capability: PG basebackup+PITR config, restore-drill automation (full-service and single-tenant), DB<->object-store integrity reconciliation reusing BI-PF-1308 lifecycle hooks and stored_objects metadata, region-aware restore routing.
dependency_findings: RELATED BI-PF-1312 for evidence of restores
conflict_findings: Integrity reconciliation overlaps BI-PF-1308 — must reuse its registry, not fork
Region-aware restore coordinates with BI-PF-1317 partition/region work
duplication_findings: BI-PF-1308 covers delete/replica/backup reconciliation at object level — extend, do not rebuild
core/service_catalog.py reusable only for service-level drill orchestration patterns
BI-PF-1317 handles region cells — restore routing must defer to it
analysis.rationale: Critical DR capability; depends on partitions and object lifecycle, reuses BI-PF-1308 reconciliation rather than duplicating it.
assumptions: Object store supports versioning/replication per BI-PF-1308
Region cells from BI-PF-1317 define restore targets
risks: Restore drills are expensive and environment-heavy — risk of never-run drills
